title: Youth Exchange & Mobility
summary: Connecting young people through global dialogues, study visits and exchange programmes that build understanding and lasting friendships.
summaryZh: 通过全球对话、参访与交流项目连接青年，增进理解并建立持久友谊。

title: Innovation & Entrepreneurship
summary: Empowering youth-led innovation through applied AI, entrepreneurial support and cross-border idea exchange.
summaryZh: 通过应用 AI、创业支持与跨境创意交流，赋能青年主导的创新。

title: Communities & Sustainability
summary: Linking local communities with partners, learning opportunities and projects that create measurable social impact.
summaryZh: 将本地社区与合作伙伴、学习机会及产生实际社会影响的项目相连接。
